description: This Java source file defines the 'PictureDetailsActivity' class, an Android activity responsible for displaying a detailed view of a picture with animations for entering and exiting the screen, including scaling, translation, color filtering, and background transitions.

classes.name: PictureDetailsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a zoomed-in image and description with animated transition effects when opening and closing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves image and description data from the intent extras, and sets up the view and pre-draw listener for the enter animation.

methods.name: runEnterAnimation
methods.description: Performs the entrance animation by scaling, translating, fading in background, and colorizing the image from grayscale to full color.

methods.name: runExitAnimation
methods.description: Performs the exit animation that reverses the entrance effects, optionally scaling the image back into the center if orientation changed, then calls the provided endAction.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Overrides the back button to run the exit animation before closing the activity.

methods.name: setSaturation
methods.description: Adjusts the saturation level of the image to create grayscale or full color effect by applying a color filter.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Overrides the default finish method to disable activity transition animations.
